summary: Full E2E testing of SparkCurv admin panel - all 13 test scenarios verified. Backend 16/16 tests pass. Frontend all flows working correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: seed_admin() only inserts admin if not existing (idempotent via update) - works correctly
Cookie samesite=none + secure=True ensures cross-domain auth works on HTTPS preview URL
CORS allows credentials with explicit FRONTEND_URL - correctly configured
No brute force lockout implemented - not a blocker but worth noting for production
seed_data_creation: Created and deleted test blog posts during testing. One live blog 'Public Blog Test' (slug: public-blog-test) exists in DB.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All features verified working: admin login, invalid credentials error, dashboard stats, create/edit/delete blog, toggle publish/draft, protected route redirect, logout, public /blog page showing published posts, /blog/:slug individual post page. Backend API: auth+blog CRUD all functional. Note: Playwright force=True click on submit button doesn't trigger form submit - use press Enter instead for form submissions.
